derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G1062 (γάμος);
def: to form affinity with, i.e. (specially) in a levirate way

occurrences.text: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
